text.formatted: When a spell you cast with a spell slot restores Hit Points to a creature, that creature regains additional Hit Points on the turn you cast the spell. The additional Hit Points equal 2 plus the spell slot's level.
text.plain: When a spell you cast with a spell slot restores Hit Points to a creature, that creature regains additional Hit Points on the turn you cast the spell. The additional Hit Points equal 2 plus the spell slot's level.

gaps.name: Apply the extra healing only on the turn this spell was cast; this condition remains prose.

prose.text: This healing occurs on the turn you cast this spell.

gap.name: Correlate this healing with the turn of its own casting.
